div.div:
Legend — independently numbered flows
A · Write / metadata sync: publish content and metadata events, poll, upsert.
B · Read / retrieval: query metadata, retrieve S3 content, save once, return blob reference.
Filled arrow = caller → callee. Normal responses are folded into request labels. Dashed = auxiliary query (B1); solid = main call.
“async” qualifies metadata publication; it does not change the line style. Three queues and three corresponding listeners are shown individually.
Cosmos DB stores metadata; S3 and temporary Blob Storage hold document content.

text.tspan: A · Write / metadata sync: publish content and metadata events, poll, upsert.
B · Read / retrieval: query metadata, retrieve S3 content, save once, return blob reference.
Filled arrow = caller → callee. Normal responses are folded into request labels. Dashed = auxiliary query (B1); solid = main call.
“async” qualifies metadata publication; it does not change the line style. Three queues and three corresponding listeners are shown individually.
Cosmos DB stores metadata; S3 and temporary Blob Storage hold document content.
